title: Can I BEAT Ouroboros King?
summary: First Ouroboros King episode: starts a New Run from the title menu (New Run, Continue Run, Practice, Archives), crosses the Kingdom of Thessalonia node map, upgrades units at the Armory and wins battles (VICTORY screen).
rules: Ouroboros King (Steam chess roguelike): you lead a small army of special units across a campaign node map (areas like Kingdom of Thessalonia, Marsh of Madness, Ridge of Ruin), fighting turn-based chess-like battles on small boards vs AI armies and bosses.

Each unit has a unique ability card, e.g. General: moves one square in any direction; if he gets killed his army demoralizes and surrenders (acts as your king). Portal mage: moves to any unoccupied square, can only kill on adjacent squares.
Between battles: Armory (upgrade one unit), relics and items, currency; VICTORY screen after a battle; final bosses (Ouroboros trio incl. Ouroboros Queen).
win_condition: Win battles by killing the enemy General/king units; clear the campaign and defeat the Ouroboros final bosses.

opponent.name: AI armies and bosses (Ouroboros Queen, final trio)
